subject: parser: Improve add more table options for compatibility (#64772)
summary: Reviewed de5c55394f vs parent 45b1597860, focusing on parser/planner changes. The commit adds parsing + AST restore support for MySQL/MariaDB table options (AUTOEXTEND_SIZE, PAGE_CHECKSUM/PAGE_COMPRESSED/PAGE_COMPRESSION_LEVEL, TRANSACTIONAL, IETF_QUOTES, SEQUENCE) and emits parser warnings for ignored options; planner precheck accepts additional MariaDB engine names (aria/myrocks/tokudb). No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, or compatibility issues found in the touched behavior.
